about: P3-profile digests (ARCHITECTURE-P3C §0 rules 5 and 9, D3, §9.5, §10.1 accept.p3c.p3-digests-*), recorded from the unchanged engine at commit cad4ac9 before any P3c code. One entry per P3 world: the 9 templates as P3 worlds, the 21 CCNA 3 labs of cad4ac9 (shards keyed by lab id: `shards` holds the frozen world ids of each shard, which the shard files read instead of the live CCNA3_LAB_ORDER), the addDevice sandbox and the two guard worlds; the fixed script of test/profile-digests.harness.ts (boot, the setup lines, the probes, one show, runFor 600 s), per-kind counts and the digest of every trace event, per-10-second-window digests, the event lines not attributable to a background PDU, the typed results, and hashes of the end snapshot normalised against p3Vocabulary. Change it only as P3C §9.5 allows, entry by entry, by re-recording the affected worlds with NF_RECORD_P3_DIGESTS=<world id> on their shard file.
